name: Rohit Bisani
headline: Engineer Program Manager
summary: Rohit is constantly in search of innovative and impactful solutions. He has field experience in semiconductor, automotive, emc and online advertising industry, various roles from software engineer to project manager. He is a good team player providing constant motivation and a strives always to bring meaning to projects he is involved in. Some of the interesting product development projects he has been involved in include - a digital glove as a game controller, wireless ecg device, algorithm development to reduce breaking distance during panic breaking, developing automation softwares and managing multi site international semiconductor project.
